description: Suijin OS v6.8.0 — Crash-Proof Engagements. An .sje exists for EVERY exit path: a crash-saver armed at engagement start funnels the conclusion save, the finally backstop, SIGTERM/SIGHUP, sys.excepthook and atexit into one idempotent once-flagged bundle write — a random crash, a teardown failure, a kill signal, or interpreter death all still leave a resumable engagement. `suijin load` now picks: bare invocation lists the ten newest bundles (date, size, cost, objective) — number, name, or path; bare names resolve from the exports inbox; non-interactive runs take the newest automatically. Resume-config hardening: stripped config placeholders can no longer leak into a resumed engagement. Benchmarks on the record: 100% Cybench HTB Cyber Apocalypse 2024 web track (9/9 flags, terminal-verified exploit chains) and 83.9% NYU CTF. 2,310+ tests green.
